value.rationale: Joint triangle and induced-hole counts are natural measures of transitivity and chordless cyclic structure; the finite-sample dependence sign is not determined by separate mean/variance laws. For all hole lengths and graph orders the theorem gives exact unique sign transition, endpoint obstruction, and strictly ordered thresholds that approach the natural edge-density fraction with a nonzero O(1/n) displacement. This is a structural finite-size phase diagram with motivated statistical relevance, rather than a single arbitrary parameter computation.
